hiddenGeometry: One model-only cartridge, twelve overlapping solid bars forming three connected octagonal case/head/rim sections. Reuses atlas texels from canonical graphite magazine_tube_0 index34 and steel silver_sleeve_0 index58; uniform existing texels avoid end-face overlap noise. Never visible at HIP, phase seams, non-FP, ADS or inspect. No detached cap.
shellVisibilityPolicy: Full size during approach/contact and insertion; no whole-mag fill. Hidden when in tube and at all phase seams; no size-fade in open air.
ammoTransferPolicy: Existing mechanical WeaponCycle one-shell transfer is authoritative. initial raises once and inserts one; subsequent loop inserts one from same held pose; return is cosmetic only.
rotationConvention: Rigid Rx Ry Rz about authored source grip; rotate source-local cartridge offset and compensate anchor. Apply .85 scale once; carry native to authored twohand frame rigidly. No additive Euler.
fallback: Exact canonical item model graph for all non-FP and ADS/inspect even during progress; negative inactive float4 selects exact canonical graph.
referenceConfidence: High exact weapon identity and held incremental reload order; medium body gesture; limited cartridge trajectory because left hand and receiver occlude contact. Camera movement and damage flashes are not extracted as motion.

motionAuthorship.body: Authored rigid grip-pivot lift and cant from visible gesture; modest held insert response; no copied Long Arm/pistol curve.
motionAuthorship.shell: Authored hidden solid cartridge, dimensions, loading anchor and partially occluded approach under receiver. Existing steel/graphite UV reused; exact red/brass ammunition material is not recoverable without new atlas ownership.
motionAuthorship.returnPose: Six-tick cosmetic return and exact canonical HIP endpoint authored to the transport contract. Actual source interrupts to fire after five one-shell transfers; it does not show a settled natural full-mag return.

integration.requiredContract: WeaponInsertPresentation supports first_in_last_out and model(entry); accepted INSERT initial0..1 / loop2..3 / cosmetic return4..5 on float4, flag0 grip, unchanged .001 collision-offset policy. No model-authored gameplay delay.
nativeQueue: Both FP hands, native/twohand grips, initial from HIP, multiple successful one-shell inserts held without repeated lift; end/interruption/cancel and cosmetic return.
ADS/inspect and equip/swap/death/disconnect restores; float collision ownership; third-person observer plus GUI/ground/head/fixed canonical.
Brief 10-20 displayed weapons for obvious defects; actual server GT, listening and native visual performance belong to master.

comparisonMethod: Independent reconstruction of emitted parent elements + child display transforms; three obliques for HIP/held/insert/return, three shell closeups and underside sequence. Storyboard pairs all twelve actual full frames with authored offline samples.
limitations: Actual source camera pans, damage flashes and hands obstruct exact local axes and cartridge tip. Curves and hidden paths are authored, not an animation extraction.
Twenty-one static display samples per phase; source video seconds do not change reload mechanics, ammo or audio.
No hands or source bones, no new third-person reload. Offline render is not native gameplay verification.
